title: Political statement from Albert Hensarling, candidate for the Jasper Hospital District Board - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago I am Albert Hensarling and I have lived my entire life in Jasper County. I did work in Lufkin, Tx for 3 years as a welder for 3 years. I met and married a Jasper girl and we started building our home just down the road from where I was raised. Together we have 2 children, our daughter Jessica and our son Rocky. Both of our children attended school until they graduated. Our daughter now lives in the same house my wife and I built. I went to work for Jasper County Precinct 1 in 1983 and was there for 26 1/2 years and took a job with a disaster cleanup company. I served on the Upper Jasper County Water Authority, and the Jasper County Child Welfare Board. I volunteered for the Angelina River VFD for approximately 25 years. I was firefighter, Training Chief, Assistant Chief and my last 2 years before a medical retirement I served as Chief ! I have always had a heart for Jasper and for serving to help the residents in and around our community. In 2018 while attending Nedville MBC, I surrendered my life to the ministry and that very night received a call from Concord MBC and they wanted me to come preach the next Sunday morning. Currently I am going into my 9th year as their Pastor. Along with my education at Jasper High School I enrolled and completed the Jasper Master Gardeners class with volunteer hours to our community. Up until a couple years ago I was enrolled in the Bethlehem Bible Institute and Seminary. I earned my Associate Degree in English Bible . I remember our Hospital as a facility that had good Doctors and the Hospital could handle most cases that came through the doors with just the more serious cases that required a higher level of care in facilities that had equipment that Jasper didn’t have. Over the years our hospital has declined and now there are no child births in Jasper, the women are sent to either Lufkin or to Beaumont , unless the birth is an emergency. Many people no longer stop at Jasper, they simply go to the larger hospitals as their first stop. I want to bring representation to ALL the people of Jasper County. I feel that I can bring a level of knowledge that fits the majority of the citizens of Jasper County. I would like to see our hospital once again be the first stop by bringing in more Doctors and Specialists. Many people can’t afford to go out of town for medical care when we have a hospital right here in Jasper. If elected, I promise to do the job to best of my ability, be willing to listen to our citizens and vote for what I believe is in our citizens best interests. I want us to once again have a hospital that we can all be proud of ! Once again, my name is Albert Hensarling and I am # 6 on the ballot. I would appreciate your support and vote and if you see fit to elect me and allow me to have the opportunity to serve you as a Board of Directors position . Thank you for your consideration and may God Bless ! Read full article
